name: Bay County Chamber of Commerce
legal_name: Bay County Chamber of Commerce Inc
serves: Callaway, Lynn Haven, Mexico Beach, Panama City, Panama City Beach, Parker, Springfield and unincorporated Bay County
about: An independent, member-owned business group (not a government agency) that runs networking events, leadership programs and advocacy for Bay County businesses. Its foundation runs Leadership Bay, Junior Leadership Bay and Bay Young Professionals.
mission: To develop, enhance, and maintain a viable business climate and provide leadership in the development of economic growth and quality of life.
board_meets: The board meets at 11 a.m. on the third Thursday of each month; members are welcome. The executive committee meets at 11 a.m. on the second Thursday; those meetings are closed.
public_money_from: Destination Panama City; Mexico Beach CDC

name: Panama City Beach Chamber of Commerce
legal_name: Panama City Beaches Chamber of Commerce Incorporated
serves: Panama City Beach and the beaches of Bay County
about: The business group for Panama City Beach, incorporated in 1987 (Sunbiz N21370). It runs Friday at the Beach, IdeaCamp, Business After Hours, two leads groups, young professionals events, the Panama City Beach Marathon and the Annual Awards Dinner.
mission: Promote the social and economic development of bay county and the beaches
public_money_from: Visit Panama City Beach; Destination Panama City
